themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Surge
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints spiked 700% this week (3 complaints vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), suggesting either a sudden influx of unlicensed or non-compliant vendors or a new enforcement/complaint awareness pattern in Parkchester/Soundview.
evidence: 3 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
Spike is statistically significant and classified as high severity
No prior sustained pattern; this represents a sharp deviation
reporting_angles: Investigate whether unlicensed vendors are setting up in parks or high-foot-traffic areas; interview Health Dept and local enforcement
Interview residents and business owners about vendor activity; determine if complaints are about sanitation, parking obstruction, or unfair competition

themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Violations of park rules jumped 352% last week (13 complaints vs. 2.9 weekly average), a statistically significant surge suggesting emerging disorder or overcrowding in district parks like Soundview Park.
evidence: 13 park rules violation complaints last week vs. 2.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (352% spike, z-score: 4.28)
Coincides with park-related noise complaints up 357% three weeks ago (4 vs. 0.9 average)
Both signals point to increased park usage or enforcement activity
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept about enforcement priorities and what violations are being reported (loitering, alcohol, noise, sports equipment, etc.)
Visit Soundview Park and surrounding parks to observe conditions; speak with regular park users and nearby residents about changes

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Infrastructure Gap
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests jumped 300% last week (3 complaints vs. 0.8 weekly average), indicating residents perceive insufficient waste receptacles in public spaces—a potential sanitation and neighborhood maintenance concern.
evidence: 3 litter basket requests THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (300% spike, z-score: 3.4)
Aligns with broader unsanitary condition complaints (669 total over 90 days, consistently high-volume category)
Could reflect both infrastructure deficit and possible recent littering uptick
reporting_angles: Map where litter basket requests are coming from; compare to actual basket density and maintenance schedules in those areas
Interview Sanitation Dept about basket placement strategy and budget constraints in Parkchester/Soundview

themes_detail.label: Heat/Hot Water Crisis Easing
themes_detail.summary: Heat and hot water complaints plummeted 74% this week (54 complaints vs. 204.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), suggesting that either seasonal warming has arrived or a recent enforcement push resolved widespread building failures—context matters for story viability.
evidence: 54 heat/hot water complaints THIS WEEK vs. 204.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (74% drop, z-score: -3.19)
Represents largest complaint category overall (2481 complaints over 90 days), so even reduction is significant for residents
Drop is sharp and recent; likely seasonal transition or specific enforcement action
reporting_angles: Investigate whether spring weather or HPD enforcement action explains the drop; compare to city-wide trends
Profile residents who suffered through winter without adequate heat; assess whether complaint drop is real improvement or complaint fatigue

themes_detail.label: Residential Noise Decline
themes_detail.summary: Residential noise complaints decreased 32% this week (139 complaints vs. 204.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), breaking a persistent pattern—though this is de-escalation rather than an emerging crisis, it may warrant investigation if underlying issue has been resolved.
evidence: 139 residential noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 204.5 weekly average (32% drop, z-score: -3.05)
Second-highest complaint category overall (2410 over 90 days), so sustained reduction benefits many residents
Drop is recent and statistically significant; contrasts with spikes in park-related noise 3 weeks ago
reporting_angles: Verify whether weather or seasonal patterns explain reduction, or whether specific enforcement/community initiative worked
Monitor for rebound in coming weeks; assess if improvement is durable
